title: Nvidia Backs Indian Startup Simplismart for Efficient AI
excerpt: Indian startup Simplismart secures backing from Nvidia to help businesses run AI models using fewer GPUs.
body_html:
Indian startup Simplismart has secured backing from Nvidia. The company helps businesses run artificial intelligence models while using fewer graphics processing units.

According to the startup, its annualized revenue run rate has experienced significant growth, multiplying 14 times over a six-month period. Additionally, the United States currently accounts for more than half of the company's overall revenue.
